steps.en: Scaffold a project and install its dependencies
steps.zh: 脚手架出项目并装好依赖

steps.en: Write the agent as files: instructions, typed tools, a channel
steps.zh: 把 agent 写成文件：指令、带类型的工具、一个渠道

steps.en: Run it and talk to it in the terminal
steps.zh: 本地跑起来，在终端里跟它对话

steps.en: Compiles those files into an HTTP service with a session runtime
steps.zh: 把这些文件编译成一个带会话运行时的 HTTP 服务

steps.en: Mark which tool calls a person must approve
steps.zh: 标出哪些工具调用必须有人批准

steps.en: Parks that turn durably while it waits for the answer — days if needed
steps.zh: 把这一轮持久地停住，等答复——等几天也行

steps.en: After a crash or a redeploy, resumes from the last completed step
steps.zh: 崩溃或重新部署后，从最后一个完成的 step 接着跑

value.en: You write files; you get a backend agent that waits days, survives redeploys, and answers on Slack — queue, state machine, sandbox and webhooks included
value.zh: 你只写文件，换来一个能等好几天、能崩能重发、还能在 Slack 应答的后端 agent

sources: https://github.com/vercel/eve README quick start (npx eve@latest init my-agent, agent/instructions.md, agent/tools/get_weather.ts, npm run dev)
docs/concepts/execution-model-and-durability.mdx (one durable workflow per session, checkpoint at step boundaries, parked work)
docs/tools/human-in-the-loop.md (approval: always()/once()/auto() from eve/tools/approval; parks durably until answered)
